detail.message: PUT is not supported on “A pacticipant” (partial). Supported: GET, DELETE. To create or update one (main branch, repository URL) use Apiome's pacticipant API. DELETE is soft: restorable until it is purged, and refused while a version is deployed unless force=true. Apiome route: /v1/tenants/{tenant}/pacticipants/{pacticipant}.
